notes: Independent flattened target for the v0.113.0 public-beta managed API, new game modes and UI contracts; do not merge into the v0.111.0 variant.
LAN joining uses the payload-owned NJoinFriendScreen.JoinGameAsync lifecycle; host services retain PeerVersionInfo.LocalDefault() and the original HandshakeManager, MessageTypes and NetMessageBus.
LAN hosting preserves the separate isCustom flag and routes Standard, Daily, Blitz and Dread through their original lobby screens; loaded custom runs use IsCustomGame.
Merchant confirmation and extended treasure-room layouts resolve the v0.113 purchase and holder shapes while retaining legacy target behavior.
